Based on the supplier agreements indexed in the corpus, only three suppliers have an **indexed price cap** clause (Clause 6, pricing adjusted annually by CPI, capped at 4%):

1. **Acme Components** — supplier-agreement-acme.docx, p.1 (Clause 6)
2. **Borealis Metals** — supplier-agreement-borealis.docx, p.1 (Clause 6)
3. **Corvid Plastics** — supplier-agreement-corvid.docx, p.1 (Clause 6)

All other supplier agreements in the data room (Dunmore Industrial, and the numbered agreements 005 through 065 — 14 additional suppliers) explicitly state in their Clause 6 that "Unit prices are fixed for the term and are not indexed," so they have no indexed price cap.
